comments: Online tool, no sign-up. Accepts any CSS color format (hex, rgb, hsl, color names), suggests the nearest passing color with the same hue for text or background, and runs entirely in the browser: nothing is sent or stored.
features: Free WCAG contrast checker. Shows the exact ratio (never rounded up) and pass/fail for AA and AAA text and non-text contrast (1.4.3, 1.4.6, 1.4.11), suggests the closest passing colors, previews color-vision deficiencies and creates a shareable link. Runs in the browser; nothing is sent or stored.
title: Etch Color Contrast Checker
